title: Vinaigrette vs mayo
hook: Same oil. *One egg yolk* turns dressing into mayo.
cover_text: Oil and vinegar, *add a yolk*, get mayo

dishes.name: Vinaigrette
dishes.text: Three parts oil to one vinegar. Shaken droplets *drift apart* in minutes.

dishes.name: Mayonnaise
dishes.text: Far less liquid, plus a *yolk*: it packs the oil into a thick, stable cream.

sheet_text: Lots of acid stays *loose*. A yolk packs the oil tight.
sources: https://app.ckbk.com/section/prof36725c21s001ss002/oil-and-vinegar-dressings (Gisslen: basic vinaigrette is 3 parts oil to 1 part vinegar)
https://www.jamesbeard.org/recipes/vinaigrette (3 to 4 parts oil to 1 part vinegar)
https://ruhlman.com/make-mayo/ (Ruhlman mayo: 1 yolk, ~10 ml water + lemon, 1 cup oil ≈ oil 100 : liquid 4–5 : yolk 8; Ratio: 20 parts oil : 1 part liquid plus yolk)
https://www.npr.org/107019086 (Ruhlman basic mayonnaise: 1 yolk per cup of oil plus a little lemon and water)
